messages:
Maya (Billing): Heads up — March invoice batch produced a bunch of negative tax lines for EU customers and a few customers showing the VAT line twice. Not good.
Liam (Eng): omg. any job ids or logs?
Maya (Billing): job id invoice-run-2026-03-22-09, saw in logs: tax-service returned two entries for 'vat' for customers with reserved_capacity credits applied. example snippet:
```
invoice_line,amount,tax_code
reserved_capacity_credit,-120.00,
vat,0.00
vat,12.00
usage_compute,120.00,
```
Maya (Billing): it looks like reserved_capacity credits are being zeroed before tax calc in some paths, then tax is recalculated on net and gross in another, so duplication.
Sara (Revenue Ops): Are there actual duplicate invoices or just duplicate tax lines on the same invoice?
Maya (Billing): same invoice has duplicate tax lines. Some totals ended up negative (invoice balance -12.00) which could block processing in Stripe.
billing-bot: invoice-run-2026-03-22-09 reported 23 warnings, 5 errors. Error summary: TAX_MISMATCH, STRIPE_EXPORT_BLOCK.
Alex (Payments): If Stripe rejects, we may create orphaned drafts. Can we pause outbound export until fix?
Liam (Eng): I can add a quick guard to the exporter to block negative total invoices and route them to manual queue. Will push a patch, but need approval to hold exports.
Maya (Billing): Please hold exports. Finance won't send statements until we reconcile. Also need a list of affected customers so we can notify sales.
Sara (Revenue Ops): Adding a safety ops task: generate manual credit memos for any overcharged customers after fix. Who owns communication?
Maya (Billing): I'll draft the customer message. SLA: notify within 24 hours and remediate in 48.
Liam (Eng): Root cause looks like a race in tax-service when reserved credits are applied asynchronously. Quick mitigation: run tax calc after credits apply (single path) and dedupe tax lines by tax_code before finalizing invoice.
Alex (Payments): Once patch is in, can we re-run the export for only affected invoices? Stripe has idempotent keys, but drafts might need manual reconciliation.
Maya (Billing): Yes. I'll compile a CSV of affected invoice ids and owners. preliminary: 17 EU customers, 3 enterprise accounts. sending to #sales-ops.
Sara (Revenue Ops): FYI @Liam — please include test in invoice runner to assert sum(line_amounts + taxes) == gross_amount and no negative tax lines.
Liam (Eng): will add test and put a canary deploy to staging. ETA 3 hours for guard, full fix tomorrow morning.
Maya (Billing): Thanks. Holding March batch exports now. I'll follow up with a customer notification draft in ~2hrs. :thumbsup:
